name: gasoltrade
caption:
WAS GASOL WORTH IT? 🎮🏀 We gave up JV, Delon Wright and more for Marc Gasol. That June, we were champions.

• Feb 7, 2019: Gasol from Memphis for Jonas Valanciunas, Delon Wright, C.J. Miles and a 2024 second-round pick
• 2019 playoffs: Gasol 9.4 PPG, 6.4 RPG, NBA champion
• JV in Memphis (2020-21): 17.1 PPG, 12.5 RPG
• JV now: back home in Lithuania with Zalgiris since 2026

Who won the Gasol trade? 👇

beats.head: WAS GASOL WORTH IT?
beats.name: GASOL
beats.vo: We traded three players and a pick for Marc Gasol. Was it worth it?
beats.dlg: WE GET MARC GASOL...|FOR JV, DELON AND MORE.

beats.head: THE RING
beats.name: GASOL
beats.vo: That spring, Gasol anchored the middle for a champion: nine point four points and six point four rebounds in the playoffs.

beats.head: JV IN MEMPHIS
beats.name: JV
beats.vo: Valanciunas thrived in Memphis: seventeen points and twelve and a half rebounds a night in twenty twenty-one.

beats.head: JV NOW
beats.name: JV
beats.vo: Today, Valanciunas is back home in Lithuania, playing for Zalgiris. And our banner still hangs.
beats.dlg: TODAY: JV IS BACK HOME,|PLAYING IN LITHUANIA.

beats.head: WHO WON?
beats.vo: A ring for a package. Who won the Gasol trade? Comment below.

facts.claim: On February 7, 2019 (Feb 7) Gasol was traded to Toronto for C. J. Miles, Jonas Valanciunas, Delon Wright and a 2024 second-round pick; NBA champion 2019 (1 ring)
